50772-famous-givers-and-their-gifts.title: Famous Givers And Their Gifts
50772-famous-givers-and-their-gifts.creator: Sarah Knowles Bolton
50772-famous-givers-and-their-gifts.description: A book by Sarah Knowles Bolton. While it is interesting to see how men have built up fortunes, as a rule, through industry, saving, and great energy, it is even more interesting to see how those fortunes have been or may be used for the benefit of mankind.

66942-the-building-in-japan.title: Published (Collotyped and hand coloured.)
66942-the-building-in-japan.creator: Unknown
66942-the-building-in-japan.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The incessant work of ten of the carpenters for two months has so progressed that every pole and railing is properly planed and skillfully shaped, measured and holed so that each piece fits the other so as to complete the building or framing of the house. Here they are making the preparation for the building or framing work.

arxiv-2109-00377.title: New Proofs of Extremal Inequalities With Applications
arxiv-2109-00377.creator: Yinfei Xu, and Guojun Chen
arxiv-2109-00377.description: Abstract The extremal inequality approach plays a key role in network information theory problems. In this paper, we propose a novel monotone path construction in product probability space. The optimality of Gaussian distribution is then established by standard perturbation arguments. The proofs of Liu-Viswanath extremal and vector Generalization of Costa’s entropy power inequality are illustrated into the unified framework.

arxiv-2109-07725.title: Sister Help: Data Augmentation for Frame-Semantic Role Labeling
arxiv-2109-07725.creator: Ayush Pancholy Miriam R. L. Petruck Swabha Swayamdipta
arxiv-2109-07725.description: Abstract While FrameNet is widely regarded as a rich resource of semantics in natural language processing, a major criticism concerns its lack of coverage and the relative paucity of its labeled data compared to other commonly used lexical resources such as PropBank and VerbNet. This paper reports on a pilot study to address these gaps.

arxiv-2212-07814.title: Fully conservative hydraulic jumps and solibores in two-layer Boussinesq fluids
arxiv-2212-07814.creator: Jānis Priede 1,2
arxiv-2212-07814.description: Abstract We consider a special type of hydraulic jumps (internal bores) which, in the vertically bounded system of two immiscible fluids with slightly different densities, conserve not only the mass and impulse but also the circulation and energy. This is possible only at specific combinations of the upstream and downstream states.

arxiv-2301-08375.title: Within-group fairness: A guidance for more sound between-group fairness
arxiv-2301-08375.creator: Sara Kim, Kyusang Yu, Yongdai Kim
arxiv-2301-08375.description: Abstract As they have a vital effect on social decision-making, AI algorithms not only should be accurate and but also should not pose unfairness against certain sensitive groups (e.g., non-white, women). Various specially designed AI algorithms to ensure trained AI models to be fair between sensitive groups have been developed.

arxiv-2312-02812.title: Simulating Vision Impairment in Virtual Reality - A Comparison of Visual Task Performance with Real and Simulated Tunnel Vision
arxiv-2312-02812.creator: Alexander Neugebauer, Nora Castner, Björn Severitt, Katarina Stingl, Iliya Ivanov, Siegfried Wahl
arxiv-2312-02812.description: Abstract Purpose: In this work, we explore the potential and limitations of simulating gaze-contingent tunnel vision conditions using Virtual Reality (VR) with built-in eye tracking technology. This approach promises an easy and accessible way of expanding study populations and test groups for visual training, visual aids, or accessibility evaluations.

arxiv-2408-08791.title: Dissipative split-charge formalism: Ohm’s law, Nyquist noise, and non-contact friction
arxiv-2408-08791.creator: Martin H. Müser
arxiv-2408-08791.description: Abstract The split-charge equilibration method is extended to describe dissipative charge transfer similarly as the Drude model, whereby the complex-valued frequency-dependent dielectric permitivities or conductivities of dielectrics and metals can be mimicked at non-zero frequencies. To demonstrate its feasibility, a resistor-capacitor circuit is simulated using an all-atom representation for resistor and capacitor.

pmc-10717570.title: An environmental scan of residential treatment service provision in Ontario
pmc-10717570.creator: Farihah Ali, Justine Law, Cayley Russell, Nikki Bozinoff, Brian Rush
pmc-10717570.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundOntario has one of the highest rates of substance-related harms in Canada. Residential treatment programs in the province provide a variety of in-house treatment services to support the needs of individuals with substance use disorders (SUD). However, these programs are not standardized, often varying in the type, quality, and availability of services offered, including evidence-based interventions such as Opioid Agonist Treatment (OAT).

pmc-10911141.title: Association between Low Vitamin D Status, Serotonin, and Clinico-Biobehavioral Parameters in Alzheimer’s Disease
pmc-10911141.creator: Anna-Lena Richter, Marlies Diepeveen-de Bruin, Michiel G.J. Balvers, Lisette C.P.G.M. de Groot, Peter Paul De Deyn, Sebastiaan Engelborghs, Renger F. Witkamp, Yannick Vermeiren
pmc-10911141.description: IntroductionStudies suggest a role of vitamin D in the progression and symptomatology of Alzheimer’s disease (AD), with few in vitro studies pointing to effects on serotonergic and amyloidogenic turnover. However, limited data exist in AD patients on the potential association with cognition and behavioral and psychological signs and symptoms of dementia (BPSD).

pmc-10994450.title: SLC35A2 somatic variants in drug resistant epilepsy: FCD and MOGHE
pmc-10994450.creator: Soad Elziny, Peter B Crino, Melodie Winawer
pmc-10994450.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). De novo somatic (post-zygotic) gene mutations affecting neuroglial progenitor cell types in embryonic cerebral cortex are increasingly identified in patients with drug resistant epilepsy (DRE) associated with malformations of cortical development, in particular, focal cortical dysplasias (FCD). Somatic variants in at least 16 genes have been linked to FCD type II, all encoding components of the mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) pathway. FCD type II is characterized histopathologically by cytomegalic dysmorphic neurons and balloon cells.

pmc-11378925.title: Vibrational spectroscopy data fusion for enhanced classification of different milk types
pmc-11378925.creator: Saeedeh Mohammadi, Aoife Gowen, Colm O'Donnell
pmc-11378925.description: The aim of this study is to classify seven types of Irish milk (butter, fresh, heart active, lactose free, light, protein, and slimline), supplied by a specific company, using vibrational spectroscopy methods: Near infrared (NIR), mid infrared (MIR), and Raman spectroscopy. In this regard, chemometric methods were used, and the impact of spectral data fusion on prediction accuracy was evaluated.

pmc-12557651.title: Efficacy of a novel steerable chest tube system in a swine model of hemothorax
pmc-12557651.creator: Maja T. Engler, Todd L. Graham, James D. Ross
pmc-12557651.description: Thoracostomy tubes (chest tubes) are the standard of care for thoracic trauma, including hemothorax. However, traditional chest tubes are susceptible to occlusion and lack the ability to be repositioned once inserted. This can lead to further life-threatening issues, such as retained hemothorax.

pmc-12663495.title: Pectins extracted from cranberry pomace: A study in physicochemical, structural, functional properties and the application in peach preservation
pmc-12663495.creator: Fan Wang, Jun Yang, Xu Yang, Xiquan Li, Xiuling Zhang, Zhili Pan, Chen Li
pmc-12663495.description: Cranberry pomace was utilized to extract pectins using various methods (water, oxalic acid, and natural deep eutectic solvent (NADES)) with or without ultrasound assistance. Ultrasound-assisted NADES extraction (US-NCPP) yielded the highest pectin content (5.53 %) and the highest galacturonic acid (GalA) content (83.20 %), indicating superior purity.

pmc-12673142.title: Curvature-corrected retinal registration of diagnostic OCT with instrument-integrated OCT
pmc-12673142.creator: Marius Briel, Ludwig Haide, Michael Meyling, Benjamin Saalfrank, Philipp Matten, Nicola Piccinelli, Gernot Kronreif, Maria Francesca Spadea, Eleonora Tagliabue, Franziska Mathis-Ullrich
pmc-12673142.description: Vitreoretinal surgery, requiring precise microscale tissue manipulation, is well-suited for robotic assistance. Image registration enhances surgeons’ visual perception by aligning high-resolution preoperative OCT images with the intraoperative environment, improving visibility of anatomical features not seen in microscope images. However, optical distortions from the cornea, lens, eye curvature, and scanning patterns challenge the use of diagnostic data in robotic navigation.

pmc-13564663.title: Comparative Analysis of Leukocyte Proportions and Morphology in Wild Muridae and Arvicolinae Rodents
pmc-13564663.creator: Eleni Rekouti, Eleftheria E. Rosmaraki, George P. Mitsainas
pmc-13564663.description: Simple SummaryWild rodents play a crucial role in our ecosystems and are frequently studied to understand how animals adapt to their environments. While much is known about the immune systems of laboratory rodents, data for wild populations—which face a variety of natural stressors—remain limited.

pmc-13625302.title: In-hospital peer-supported human milk bank management model and its association with human milk feeding proportions and clinical outcomes in extremely preterm infants: a recipient-to-voluntary-donor approach
pmc-13625302.creator: Xinxin Song, Aifen Cao, Yubing Dong, Qingling Yu, Xueyu Chen, Xiaoyun Xiong
pmc-13625302.description: BackgroundHuman milk feeding proportions among preterm infants remain unsatisfactory, and donor human milk is recommended as the best alternative when mother’s own milk is insufficient. Although established human milk banks provide essential donor human milk services, some settings may face challenges related to donor continuity and the timely alignment of donor milk supply with recipient demand.

pmc-13682064.title: Asymmetric metaphyseal cones versus medial modular block augment with central cone for medial tibial defects
pmc-13682064.creator: Yi Ren, Chloe E. H. Scott, Nick D. Clement, Shuqiao Xie, Pankaj Pankaj
pmc-13682064.description: AimsManaging large medial tibial bone defects during total knee arthroplasty (TKA) remains technically demanding, particularly in elderly patients. This study quantitatively compares two reconstructive strategies: ‘bridging’ the defect using an asymmetric metaphyseal cone versus ‘anatomical reconstruction’ employing a symmetrical cone with a metallic block augment, and assesses their sensitivity to osteoporotic bone quality.

uslaw-usc-t33-s3904.title: 33 U.S.C. § 3904 — Eligible entities
uslaw-usc-t33-s3904.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t33-s3904.description: United States Code, Title 33 (Navigation And Navigable Waters); Chapter 52 (Water Infrastructure Finance And Innovation). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The following entities are eligible to receive assistance under this chapter: (1) A corporation. (2) A partnership. (3) A joint venture. (4) A trust. (5) A Federal, State, or local governmental entity, agency, or instrumentality. (6) A tribal government or consortium.

uslaw-usc-t38-s3110.title: 38 U.S.C. § 3110 — Leaves of absence
uslaw-usc-t38-s3110.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t38-s3110.description: United States Code, Title 38 (Veterans’ Benefits); Part III (Readjustment And Related Benefits); Chapter 31 (Training And Rehabilitation For Veterans With Service-Connected Disabilities). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary shall prescribe such regulations as the Secretary determines necessary for granting leaves of absence to veterans pursuing rehabilitation programs under this chapter. During authorized leaves of absence, a veteran shall be considered.
